name: Art of the Dragon: Blood / ninja card not draconic does not earn go again
printed_text: When this attacks, if it is Draconic, it gets **go again** and the next 3 Draconic cards you play this turn cost {r} less to play.

name: Escalate Violence / no controlled might does not create three more
